name: test-results
title: Test Results
description: Inspect the input, expected value and actual result of each test.
usage: <TestResults results={[{ input: "UI-23", expected: true, actual: false }]} />
useCases: After checking a solution, a student selects a failing case and compares its input, expected value and actual result.
During review, a student asks about a particular mismatch. The app sends the selected case to a tutor through onAsk.
task: Inspect the input, expected value and actual result of each test.
behavior: Each results entry contains input, expected and actual. onAsk receives the selected case and the button to which focus can return.
